business_summary: Wangneng Environment Co.,Ltd provides solid waste solutions in China. It engages in the investment, construction, and operation of waste incineration power generation, food waste recycling, wastewater treatment, sludge treatment, and rubber recycling. The company was formerly known as Zhejiang Mizuda printing&dyeing group co.,Ltd and changed its name to Wangneng Environment Co.,Ltd in January 2018. Wangneng Environment Co.,Ltd was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Huzhou, China.
business_summary_ko: Wangneng Environment Co.,Ltd는 중국에 고형 폐기물 솔루션을 제공합니다. 폐기물 소각 발전, 음식물 쓰레기 재활용, 폐수 처리, 슬러지 처리, 고무 재활용 등의 투자, 건설, 운영을 영위하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 이전에 Zhejiang Mizuda Printing & Dyeing Group co.,Ltd로 알려졌으며 2018년 1월에 Wangneng Environment Co.,Ltd로 이름을 변경했습니다. Wangneng Environment Co.,Ltd는 1993년에 설립되었으며 중국 후저우에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
